name: Rattling the Rattlecages
summary: In Deathknell, newly awakened Forsaken face a test against the Rattlecage Skeletons. Shadow Priest Sarvis sends them to destroy twelve skeletons and prove they can defend their hard-won freedom.

sections.title: A Test of Resolve
sections.body: Newly risen Forsaken face a harder trial after culling the mindless zombies in Deathknell. Shadow Priest Sarvis sends recruits against the Rattlecage Skeletons roaming the settlement’s outskirts. The animated bones have no sapience or self-control, yet strike harder and fight more fiercely than the nearby decaying corpses. Surviving their clattering ambushes shows Sarvis that a recruit can withstand immediate pressure.

sections.title: Defending Newly Won Freedom
sections.body: Destroying the skeletons protects Deathknell from the lingering grip of the Lich King and tests which recruits can endure the fight. Those who fail or hesitate risk becoming like the mindless wretches wandering the woods. Overcoming the Rattlecages proves to Sarvis that you have the mettle to face a world that despises your existence.

faq.answer: Rattlecage Skeletons are mindless undead still held by the Lich King. Stripped of flesh and cognitive will, they roam Deathknell’s edges and attack anyone who crosses their path.

faq.q: Why does Shadow Priest Sarvis want the skeletons destroyed?
faq.answer: Sarvis tests newly awakened Forsaken for combat skill and willpower under pressure. Thinning the aggressive skeletons also helps keep Deathknell from being overwhelmed by the Scourge.

faq.q: Where are the Rattlecage Skeletons found?
faq.answer: Rattlecage Skeletons roam the northern and northeastern borders of the Deathknell valley, just beyond the village where mindless zombies wander.

faq.q: What happens after completing this quest?
faq.answer: Sarvis considers your initial training complete and declares you have proven worthy of your freedom. He sends you to other leaders in Deathknell to aid the Forsaken’s broader operations.

faq.q: Why are some undead free while these skeletons remain mindless?
faq.answer: After the Lich King’s telepathic hold wavered following the Third War, some undead broke free, reclaimed their sentience, and formed the Forsaken. Constructs and simple animated bones like the Rattlecages kept no personality or will and remained bound to the Scourge.

Shadow Priest Sarvis oversees the Forsaken in Deathknell’s chapel. He evaluates newly raised undead, guides them through their awakening, and makes sure they are strong enough to survive as free beings.

angles.text: As a Forsaken, the Rattlecages show what awaits if your mind slips. Their mindless servitude stands against your hard-won autonomy.
As a member of the Horde, you help temper new Forsaken soldiers into fighters who can defend their fledgling faction and secure Tirisfal Glades.
As a newly risen Priest, working for Shadow Priest Sarvis gives you an early glimpse of the ruthless pragmatism that shapes the Forsaken’s spiritual path.
